original: (296v/596) nairātmyetyādiyoginīcakram adhikṛtya madhyakrameṇa nirdeśārtham āha | athetyādi | yathā kathitaṃ bhagavatā saṃkṣepatas tathaiva vakṣya iti saṃgītikāraḥ | khadhātuvacanena śūnyatābodhirūpa eko yogo darśitaḥ | tadaṅgāni tv āsanahṛdbījādyupekṣāparyantā bhāvanāḥ saptamoktā draṣṭavyāḥ |
analyzed: nairātmya ityādi yoginīcakram adhikṛtya madhya krameṇa nirdeśa artham āha atha ityādi yathā kathitam bhagavatā saṃkṣepataḥ tathā eva vakṣye iti saṃgīti kāraḥ khadhātu vacanena śūnyatā bodhi rūpaḥ ekaḥ yogaḥ darśitaḥ tad aṅgāni tu āsana hṛd bīja ādi upekṣā paryantāḥ bhāvanāḥ saptama uktāḥ draṣṭavyāḥ

original: khadhātor madhye sūryamaṇḍalam ity anena repheṇa sūryaṃ purata ityādi sūcitam |
analyzed: kha dhātoḥ madhye sūrya maṇḍalam iti anena repheṇa sūryam puratas ityādi sūcitam

original: (297r/597) vajrapañjaraṃ bījasaṃgrahārtham | tadanu pūrvapūjitaśūnyībhūtajhaṭitadṛṣṭeṣṭadevatāpariṇatāṃ trikoṇatvena dharmodayāsādharmyāt sarvāvaraṇavarjitatvāc ca śaraccandradhavalāṃ mahatīṃ kāyatrayātmakavajradharasvabhāvatvena trikoṇāṃ dharmodayamudrāṃ vicintya tanmadhya ādhāracakraṃ cintayet | katham ity āha | cakram iti kūṭāgāram |
analyzed: vajra pañjaram bīja saṃgraha artham tadanu pūrva pūjita śūnyībhūta jhaṭita dṛṣṭa iṣṭadevatā pariṇatām trikoṇa tvena dharma udaya asādharmyāt sarva āvaraṇa varjita tvāt ca śarad candra dhavalām mahatīm kāya traya ātmaka vajradhara svabhāva tvena trikoṇām dharma udaya mudrām vicintya tad madhye ādhāra cakram cintayet katham iti āha cakram iti kūṭāgāram

original: pūrvaṃ prathamam | yathānyāyaṃ nyāyā(297v/598)natikramataḥ pṛthivyādipariṇatam | tadanantaraṃ devatānāṃ yathodayam iti pañcākārānullaṅghanena cintayed ity anuvartate | imam uddeśaṃ nirdiśati | cakram iti maṇḍalaṃ sarvatra saṃbadhyate | kṣoṇīmaṇḍalaṃ jalamaṇḍalam ityādi |
analyzed: pūrvam prathamam yathānyāyam nyāya anatikramataḥ pṛthivī ādi pariṇatam tad anantaram devatānām yathodayam iti pañca ākārān ullaṅghanena cintayet iti anuvartate imam uddeśam nirdiśati cakram iti maṇḍalam sarvatra saṃbadhyate kṣoṇī maṇḍalam jala maṇḍalam ityādi

original: pūrvam iti prathamam agnivāyumaṇḍalāpekṣayā kṣoṇījalamaṇḍalayor api nirdeśānukramād eva pūrvāparābhāvo veditavyaḥ | yathānyāyam iti vāyumaṇḍalopary agnis tadupari jalaṃ tadupari pṛthvīmaṇḍalaṃ bhāvyam ity eṣa nyāyaḥ | tathaiva (298r/599) bhājanalokasya maṇḍalānām avasthānāt | devatānām ity api sarvatra saṃbandhanīyam |
analyzed: pūrvam iti prathamam agni vāyu maṇḍala apekṣayā kṣoṇī jala maṇḍalayoḥ api nirdeśa anukramāt eva pūrva apara abhāvaḥ veditavyaḥ yathānyāyam iti vāyu maṇḍala upari agniḥ tad upari jalam tad upari pṛthvī maṇḍalam bhāvyam iti eṣa nyāyaḥ tathā eva bhājana lokasya maṇḍalānām avasthānāt devatānām iti api sarvatra saṃbandhanīyam

original: devatānāṃ tattadviśuddhirūpāṇāṃ locanādīnām imāni maṇḍalāni tadrūpāṇi draṣṭavyānīti yāvat | bījāni tu vāyvādīnāṃ yaṁ-raṁ-vaṁ-laṁ-kārāḥ |
analyzed: devatānām tad tad viśuddhi rūpāṇām locana ādīnām imāni maṇḍalāni tad rūpāṇi draṣṭavyāni iti yāvat bījāni tu vāyu ādīnām

original: bhāvakaś ceti śūnyatākāruṇābhinnabodhicittarūpo yathodayam udayānatikrameṇa nirmāteva pṛthivyādimaṇḍalānāṃ draṣṭavyaḥ | dharmodayodbhavam iti | dharmodayāyām udbhava utpādo 'syeti | cakraṃ kūṭāgāraṃ caturmahābhūtasaṃhāra(298v/600)jam iti sāmarthyāt | dvipuṭaṃ vajrāvalīparicchinnapuṭadvayopetatvāt | śuddhaṃ svacchatvāt | nirāmayaṃ nirdoṣatvāt |
analyzed: bhāvakaḥ ca iti śūnyatā kāruṇā bhinna bodhi citta rūpaḥ yathā udayam udaya anatikrameṇa nirmātā iva pṛthivī ādi maṇḍalānām draṣṭavyaḥ dharma udaya udbhavam iti dharma udayāyām udbhavaḥ utpādaḥ iti cakram kūṭāgāram catur mahābhūta saṃhāra jam iti sāmarthyāt dvi puṭam vajra āvalī paricchinna puṭa dvaya upeta tvāt śuddham svaccha tvāt nirāmayam nirdoṣa tvāt

original: kiñjalkena bhaved ekam iti | kiñjalkopalakṣitam aṣṭadalakamalaṃ garbhapuṭam | trikāyadharavajriṇam iti kāyatrayātmakavajradhare trikoṇadharmodayārūpe dharmodayāyāṃ sthitakuṭāgārodare madhyapadmād bāhyaṃ dvitīyaṃ bahiḥpuṭam ity arthaḥ | caturasratvādayaś cāsya guṇā (299r/601) vakṣyante | āsanāni candramaṇḍalāni |
analyzed: kiñjalkena bhavet ekam iti kiñjalka upalakṣitam aṣṭadala kamalam garbhapuṭam tri kāya dhara vajriṇam iti kāya traya ātmaka vajradhare trikoṇa dharmodayā rūpe dharmodayāyām sthita kuṭāgāra udare madhya padmāt bāhyam dvitīyam bahis puṭam iti arthaḥ catur asra tva ādayaḥ ca asya guṇāḥ vakṣyante āsanāni candra maṇḍalāni

original: tasyeti śavasya sacandrasya upari hṛdi candraḥ | mārtaṇḍam ākrāntam iti | ākrāmati smety ākrāntaḥ sūryasthaṃ candrasthabījopari paścād bhāvayed ity arthaḥ | yathoktaṃ prāk | candrāliḥ kāli mārtaṇḍa bījaṃ madhyagataṃ bhaved iti | dvayor melā mahat sukham iti | vijñānādhiṣṭhiteti śeṣaḥ | tathaiva janmādāv anubhūtatvāt |
analyzed: tasya iti śavasya sa candrasya upari hṛdi candraḥ mārtaṇḍam ākrāntam iti ākrāmati sma iti ākrāntaḥ sūrya stham candra stha bīja upari paścāt bhāvayet iti arthaḥ yathā uktam prāk candra āliḥ kāli mārtaṇḍa bījam madhya gatam bhavet iti dvayoḥ melā mahat sukham iti vijñāna dhiṣṭhitā iti śeṣaḥ tathā eva janma ādau anubhūta tvāt

original: iha ca tathaiva vijñānarūpa(299v/602)bījādhiṣṭhitaś candrasūryasamāgamo 'yaṃ bhāvyate |
analyzed: iha ca tathā eva vijñāna rūpa 299v602 bīja dhiṣṭhitaḥ candra sūrya samāgamaḥ yam bhāvyate

original: candrasūryayor bījam āha | sthitetyādi | ālikālipariṇatau tau | gauryādīnām apy evam evotpattir ity āha | candretyādi | candrasūryamilanam eva kāraṇe kāryopacārāt | gauryādyā ity uktam | vajrādyā iti vaktavye | gauryādyeti yad uktaṃ tatkramotpattinirāsārtham | sarvāsām ekadaivotpādāt |
analyzed: candra sūryayoḥ bījam āha sthita ityādi āli kāli pariṇatau tau gaurī ādīnām api evam eva utpattiḥ iti āha candra ityādi candra sūrya milanam eva kāraṇe kārya upacārāt gaurī ādyāḥ iti uktam vajra ādyāḥ iti vaktavye gaurī ādya iti yat uktam tad krama utpatti nirāsa artham sarvāsām ekadā eva utpādāt

original: nanu pañcajñānamayapañcākārābhisaṃbodhād buddhatvaṃ na puna(300r/603)ś candrādibhāvanayety āha | ādarśetyādi | ādṛśyante bimbāni pratisvarūpeṇāsminn ity ādarśaḥ | svacchaṃ darpaṇādi | evaṃ jñānam apy atisvaccham ādarśajñānam ucyate | yasmin jagad darpaṇa iva pratibhāti tad vidyate | tādātmyenāsminn ity ādarśajñānavāṃś candraḥ |
analyzed: nanu pañca jñāna maya pañca ākāra abhisaṃbodhāt buddhatvam na punar candra ādi bhāvanayā iti āha ādarśa ityādi ādṛśyante bimbāni prati svarūpeṇa asmin iti ādarśaḥ svaccham darpaṇa ādi evam jñānam api ati svaccham ādarśa jñānam ucyate yasmin jagat darpaṇe iva pratibhāti tat vidyate tādātmyena asmin iti ādarśa jñānavān candraḥ

original: candrabhāvanaivādarśabhāvanety arthaḥ | candrarūpam eva mano 'tisvaccham ādarśaṃ sarvasya jagata ity abhisandhiḥ | samatājñānaṃ yena (300v/604) tathā pratibimbitasya jagataḥ samatāṃ pratipadyati | tadātmakaḥ samatājñānasaptasaptikaḥ sūryaḥ saptasaptayo 'śvā asyeti kṛtvā | sūryabhāvanaiva samatājñānabhāvanety arthaḥ |
analyzed: candra bhāvanā eva ādarśa bhāvanā iti arthaḥ candra rūpam eva mano ti svaccham ādarśam sarvasya jagataḥ iti abhisandhiḥ samatā jñānam yena tathā pratibimbitasya jagataḥ samatām pratipadyati tad ātmakaḥ samatā jñāna saptasaptikaḥ sūryaḥ śvā asya iti kṛtvā sūrya bhāvanā eva samatā jñāna bhāvanā iti arthaḥ

original: candrasūryasamāgame mahāsukhamayasya manasaḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ pratibimbopamatvenāpi bhedānīkṣaṇāt | pratyavekṣaṇājñānaṃ yena tathā samāhita eva sarvasattvānāṃ cittacaritāni pratyavekṣate tad iha bījaiś cihnaṃ svadevasya pratyavekṣaṇam ucyate |
analyzed: candra sūrya samāgame mahā sukha mayasya manasaḥ sarva dharmāṇām pratibimba upama tvena api bheda anīkṣaṇāt pratyavekṣaṇa ajñānam yena tathā samāhitaḥ eva sarva sattvānām citta caritāni pratyavekṣate tat iha bījaiḥ cihnam sva devasya pratyavekṣaṇam ucyate

original: bījotpannatvena (301r/605) bījādhiṣṭhitatvena ca bījair lakṣitaṃ svadevatācihnaṃ pratyavekṣaṇājñānam ity arthaḥ | tad dhi jagadarthanirūpaṇā paramāvirbhūtam ity abhisandhiḥ |
analyzed: bīja utpanna tvena bīja adhiṣṭhita tvena ca bījaiḥ lakṣitam sva devatā cihnam pratyavekṣaṇa ajñānam iti arthaḥ tat hi jagat artha nirūpaṇā parama āvirbhūtam iti abhisandhiḥ

original: bījair iti bahuvacanaṃ devīnāṃ bījanānātvāt | cihnam ity ekavacanaṃ cihnasya nīlavajrasyaikatvāt pañcadaśānām | kṛtyānuṣṭhānaṃ yena tathā pratyavekṣitasya jagato 'parimitair nirmāṇaiḥ kṛtyam anutiṣṭhati |
analyzed: bījaiḥ iti bahuvacanam devīnām bīja nānātvāt cihnam iti ekavacanam cihnasya nīla vajrasya ekatvāt pañcadaśānām kṛtyā anuṣṭhānam yena tathā pratyavekṣitasya parimitaiḥ nirmāṇaiḥ kṛtyam anutiṣṭhati

original: tad iha sarvair ekam anuṣṭhānam ucyate (301v/606) sarvair iti candrasūryabījacihannirmāṇair jagatāṃ ca sahaikyaṃ sarvathā sarvaprapañcopaśamāt samarasībhāvaḥ | ayam atraikakṣaṇābhisaṃbodha ekasminn eva kṣaṇe sarvasya jagataḥ sarvaprapañcarahitasya tathābhisaṃbodhāt | bimbaniṣpattiḥ śuddhita iti |
analyzed: tat iha sarvaiḥ ekam anuṣṭhānam ucyate sarvaiḥ iti candra sūrya bīja cihat nirmāṇaiḥ jagatām ca saha aikyam sarvathā sarva prapañca upaśamāt samarasībhāvaḥ ayam atra eka kṣaṇa abhisaṃbodhaḥ ekasmin eva kṣaṇe sarvasya jagataḥ sarva prapañca rahitasya tathā abhisaṃbodhāt bimba niṣpattiḥ śuddhitaḥ iti

original: tadanantaraṃ devatākārapariniṣpattiḥ suviśuddhadharmadhātujñānam ity arthaḥ | tasyā eva suviśuddhadharmadhātujñānarūpatvāt | ākārāṃ pañcajñānamayāṃ (302r/607) vidhānaiḥ kathitaiḥ candrādibhiḥ | ādikarmikaḥ tadadhimokṣataḥ | kiṃcitpariniṣpannas tu kathitair eva vidhānais tadarthakiṃcitsākṣātkāraḥ |
analyzed: tad anantaram devatā ākāra pariniṣpattiḥ su viśuddha dharmadhātu jñānam iti arthaḥ tasyāḥ eva su viśuddha dharmadhātu jñāna rūpa tvāt ākārām pañcajñāna mayām vidhānaiḥ kathitaiḥ candra ādibhiḥ ādikarmikaḥ tad adhimokṣataḥ kiṃcid pariniṣpannaḥ tu kathitaiḥ eva vidhānaiḥ tad artha kiṃcid sākṣātkāraḥ

original: iha hetoś caturjñānamayatve 'pi mahāsukham ādhimokṣikam asty eva | ata evāsau hetur vajradhara ucyate | pañcākārābhisaṃbodhāv api hi mahāsukham ādhimokṣikam | ata eva devīsaṃpuṭitatvena mahāsukhābhisaṃbodhipariniṣpattā eva vajradharotpattir iti | saiva vastutaḥ pañcākārābhisaṃbodhiḥ | saiva ceha (302v/608) nairātmyāherukamaṇḍale darśitā |
analyzed: iha hetoḥ catur jñāna maya tve mahā sukham ādhimokṣikam asti eva atas eva asau hetuḥ vajradharaḥ ucyate pañca ākāra abhisaṃbodhau api hi mahā sukham ādhimokṣikam atas eva devī saṃpuṭita tvena mahā sukha abhisaṃbodhi pariniṣpattiḥ eva vajradhara utpattiḥ iti sā eva vastutas pañca ākāra abhisaṃbodhiḥ sā eva ca iha nairātmya āheruka maṇḍale darśitā

original: iha tu nairātmyāmaṇḍale mahāsukham upadeśagamyaṃ na cāpy evaṃ dhag ity āmukhībhavati | ata eva madhyo 'yaṃ kramaḥ | prajñopāyasaṃpuṭatve tu parisphuṭaṃ tad ity adhimātro 'sāv upadiśyate | ata eva ca tantrāntareṣu candrādikrameṇa pañcākārābhisaṃbodhāya vuktāyām api na mahāsukharūpatopadiśyate |
analyzed: iha tu mahā sukham upadeśa gamyam na ca api evam iti āmukhībhavati atas eva madhyaḥ yam kramaḥ prajñā upāya saṃpuṭa tve tu parisphuṭam tat iti upadiśyate atas eva ca tantra antareṣu candra ādi krameṇa pañca ākāra abhisaṃbodhāya vuktāyām api na mahā sukha rūpa tā upadiśyate

original: evaṃvidheṣv eva tu yogayoginītantreṣu mahāsukhamayī vajradharabhūmiḥ (303r/609) parisphuṭā | tadanu sārato 'nyatrāpi pratīyate na tūpadiśyate sahajasekam antareṇa | bhagavadājñayaiva | sahajasekas tv evaṃvidheṣv eva tantreṣu |
analyzed: evaṃvidheṣu eva tu yoga yoginī tantreṣu mahā sukha mayī vajradhara bhūmiḥ parisphuṭā tadanu sārataḥ nyatra api pratīyate na tu upadiśyate sahaja sekam antareṇa bhagavat ājñayā eva sahaja sekaḥ tu evaṃvidheṣu eva tantreṣu

original: hetuvajradharam antareṇa na phalavajradharotpattir ity āha | ālītyādi | viṣṭara āsanam | candrasūryamadhyasthacihnāntargatabījarūpo 'tra hetuvajradharaḥ | akṣarād udbhavataḥ piṇḍasya vajrasattvadehasya | hūm iti padmacālana(303v/610)kāloccāryamāṇaṃ pītaphaṭkāraś ca vajrāgrarandhrayor bodhicittadhāraṇāya bhāvyamāno neṣyate 'yogātreti śeṣaḥ |
analyzed: hetu vajradharam antareṇa na phala vajradhara utpattiḥ iti āha āli ityādi viṣṭaraḥ āsanam hetu vajradharaḥ akṣarāt udbhavataḥ piṇḍasya vajra sattva dehasya hūm iti padma cālana kāla uccāryamāṇam pīta phaṭkāraḥ ca vajra agra randhrayoḥ bodhi citta dhāraṇāya bhāvyamānaḥ neṣyate yoga atrā iti śeṣaḥ

original: sattvabimbasamudbhūtam iti | anantaroktahetuvajradharajātam | maṇḍaleśam iti nairātmyām | etad uktam | catvāri jñānāni hetubhūtāni pañcaphalam iti | tat kiṃ phalavajradharo na pañcajñānamayaḥ | naivaṃ śuddhiśuddhānām eṣāṃ tadrūpeṇotpatteḥ | indriyādyudayakrameṇa spharaṇasaṃharaṇakrameṇa (304r/611) tāny eva hi suviśuddhāni dṛśyante |
analyzed: sattva bimba samudbhūtam iti anantara ukta hetu vajradhara jātam maṇḍala īśam iti etat uktam catvāri jñānāni hetu bhūtāni pañca phalam iti tat kim phala vajradharaḥ na pañcajñāna mayaḥ na evam śuddhi śuddhānām eṣām tad rūpeṇa utpatteḥ indriya ādi udaya krameṇa spharaṇa saṃharaṇa krameṇa tāni eva hi su viśuddhāni dṛśyante

original: pūrvavad iti | pūjāpāpadeśanādyartham ānītanairātmyāvat | bhagavatā hi vaktracihnābharaṇādikaṃ pratipādito vajragarbhaḥ pūrvaṃ paścāc ca saṅgītaṃ tu punaruktabhayāt paścād eva bhagavadājñayaiva | bhagavateva guruṇā pūrvaṃ pratipādayitavyam ity abhisandhinā |
analyzed: pūrvavat iti pūjā pāpa deśanā ādi artham ānīta nairātmyā vat bhagavatā hi vaktra cihna ābharaṇa ādikam pratipāditaḥ vajragarbhaḥ pūrvam paścāt ca saṅgītam tu punarukta bhayāt paścāt eva bhagavat ājñayā eva bhagavatā iva guruṇā pūrvam pratipādayitavyam iti abhisandhinā

original: candrakānto maṇir nirlanthanaḥ pūrṇacandropamas tatprabheva prabhā yasya (304v/612) candraprabham ity arthaḥ | upalakṣaṇaṃ caitad āsanasyāpi | raudratve 'pi devīcandrāsanacandraprabhety arthaḥ | evaṃ sarve ceti tadāparāś caturdaśa yoginyaḥ | prajñopāyasvabhāvata iti pratyavekṣaṇākṛtyānuṣṭhānajñānayor api tanmayatvāt |
analyzed: candrakāntaḥ maṇiḥ nirlanthanaḥ pūrṇa candra upamaḥ tad prabhā iva prabhā yasya candra prabham iti arthaḥ upalakṣaṇam ca etat āsanasya api raudra tve devī candra āsana candra prabhā iti arthaḥ evam sarve ca iti tadā aparāḥ caturdaśa yoginyaḥ prajñā upāya svabhāvataḥ iti pratyavekṣaṇa ākṛtyā anuṣṭhāna jñānayoḥ api tad maya tvāt

original: asyaiva nirdeśaḥ prajñālītyādi | varṇabheda iti | āṁ iṁ īṁ uṁ aṁ ḷṁ eṁ aiṁ oṁ ūṁ ṛṁ ṝṁ ḹṁ aiṁ aṁ iti bījabhedo yathākramaṃ vajrādīnām | pañcaskandhasvabhāveneti | (305r/613) tattadarthaviśuddhisvabhāvā bhāvanīyā yoginyo na tv enam eveti darśayati | gauryādayo vajrā diksthā | pukkasyādaya īśānādikoṇasthā dakṣiṇāvartataḥ |
analyzed: asya eva nirdeśaḥ prajñālī ityādi varṇa bhedaḥ iti āṁ iṁ īṁ uṁ aṁ ḷṁ eṁ aiṁ oṁ ūṃ ṛṁ ṝṁ ḹṁ aiṁ aṁ iti bīja bhedaḥ yathākramam vajra ādīnām pañca skandha svabhāvena iti tad tad artha viśuddhi svabhāvāḥ bhāvanīyāḥ yoginyaḥ na tu enam eva iti darśayati gaurī ādayaḥ vajrā diś sthā pukkasī ādayaḥ īśāna ādi koṇa sthāḥ dakṣiṇa āvartataḥ

original: adhāvati rakṣatīti adhavatī | ekam ūrdhvavatī ke punas te ity āha | khecarī bhūcarīti | bhūcarī bhavasvabhāvena sthitādhogatitvāt | ata eva sādhomukhī | khecarī nirvāṇasvabhāvena sthitā (305v/614) ūrdhvagatitvāt | ata eva sā ūrdhvamukhī | pārśvavartinīti | nairātmyāyā adhaḥ paścimapārśve bhūcarī | ūrdhvaṃ pūrvapārśve khecarī |
analyzed: adhāvati rakṣati iti adhavatī ekam ūrdhvavatī ke punar te iti āha khecarī bhūcarī iti bhūcarī bhava svabhāvena sthitā adhogati tvāt atas eva sā adhomukhī khecarī nirvāṇa svabhāvena sthitā ūrdhva gati tvāt atas eva sā ūrdhva mukhī pārśva vartinī iti nairātmyāyāḥ adhas paścima pārśve bhūcarī ūrdhvam pūrva pārśve khecarī

original: viśvavarṇā iti bāhyapuṭasthā aṣṭau ṣoḍaśabhujamaṇḍalavat | pītādivarṇāḥ | mahāraudrā ityādi viśeṣaṇāni sarvāsām | viśeṣas tu mūla eva | cakryādayaḥ śiraḥkarṇakaṇṭhakarakaṭiṣu | etādṛśā iti nīlavarṇasāmyaṃ tyaktvā | kīdṛśī nairātmyety āha | (306r/615) yogapātrīti raktapūrṇakapālam | jvaladdīpteti | kāyena jvalantī cetasā dīptā | nīlavarṇeti |
analyzed: viśva varṇāḥ iti bāhya puṭa sthāḥ aṣṭau ṣoḍaśa bhuja maṇḍala vat pīta ādi varṇāḥ mahāraudrāḥ ityādi viśeṣaṇāni sarvāsām viśeṣaḥ tu mūle eva cakri ādayaḥ śiraḥ karṇa kaṇṭha kara kaṭiṣu etādṛśāḥ iti nīla varṇa sāmyam tyaktvā kīdṛśī nairātmyā iti āha yogapātrī iti rakta pūrṇa kapālam jvalat dīptā iti kāyena jvalantī cetasā dīptā nīla varṇā iti

original: anena adhyātmapuṭavartinyo bhūcarīkhecaryaś ca nīlā ity uktam | seti nairātmyā | ṣoḍaśabhujamaṇḍalavad atrāpi dvārapālyaḥ pūjādevyaś ca boddhavyāḥ | viśeṣaṃ tv āha | dakṣiṇa ityādi | upalakṣaṇaṃ pūrvapaścimayoḥ | tatra pūrvadvāre hayāsyā sitanīlā | dakṣiṇe sūkarāsyā pītanīlā | paścime śvānāsyā raktanīlā | uttare siṃhāsyā maraktanīlā |
analyzed: anena adhyātma puṭa vartinyaḥ bhūcarī khecaryaḥ ca nīlāḥ iti uktam sā iti nairātmyā ṣoḍaśa bhuja maṇḍala vat atra api dvārapālyaḥ pūjā devyaḥ ca boddhavyāḥ viśeṣam tu āha dakṣiṇe ityādi upalakṣaṇam pūrva paścimayoḥ tatra pūrva dvāre haya āsyā sita nīlā dakṣiṇe sūkara āsyā pīta nīlā paścime śvāna āsyā rakta nīlā uttare siṃha āsyā marakta nīlā

original: catasro (306v/616) 'py etāḥ kartrīkapālabhṛdbhujadvayāḥ | nāmānurūpaikavaktrā | hasitākrodhaśṛṅgāreti viśeṣaṇaṃ trayoviṃśater api devīnām | tatpūjāsvarūpam iti | īśānādikoṇeṣu vaṃśā vīṇā mukundā murajā devyaḥ pūrvavad veditavyāḥ | etena śūnyatādiyogatrayam uktam |
analyzed: catasraḥ api etāḥ kartrī kapālabhṛt bhuja dvayāḥ nāma anurūpa eka vaktrā hasitā krodha śṛṅgārā iti viśeṣaṇam trayoviṃśateḥ api devīnām tad pūjā svarūpam iti īśāna ādi koṇeṣu vaṃśāḥ vīṇāḥ mukundāḥ murajāḥ devyaḥ pūrvavat veditavyāḥ etena śūnyatā ādi yoga trayam uktam

original: tadanantarabhāvanīyaṃ tu caturthaṃ yogam āha | trītyādi | tritattvasvarūpāṇi oṁ-āḥ-hūṁ-akṣarāṇi | taiḥ śiraḥkaṇṭhahṛt(307r/617)su yuktam ātmānam | madhyamam iti | madhyāsane sthitvā mā svaparārthasaṃpattir asyeti kṛtvā | ayam atrābhisamayakramaḥ |
analyzed: tad anantara bhāvanīyam tu caturtham yogam āha tri ityādi tri tattva svarūpāṇi oṁ āḥ hūṁ akṣarāṇi taiḥ śiraḥ kaṇṭha hṛd yuktam ātmānam madhyamam iti madhyāsane sthitvā mā sva para artha saṃpattiḥ asya iti kṛtvā ayam atra abhisamaya kramaḥ

original: svahṛdbījamayūkhākṛṣṭanairātmyāmaṇḍalam aṣṭadevībhiḥ saṃpūjya pāpadeśanādikaṃ yāvat kūṭāgāraṃ tatra dvipuṭaṃ maṇḍalaṃ trayoviṃśatiśavāsanasahitaṃ pratiśavam urasi candre ālikālijacandrasūryasvasvabījacihnabījapariṇatās trayoviṃśati(307v/618)yoginyo bhāvanīyāḥ |
analyzed: sva hṛd bīja mayūkha ākṛṣṭa nairātmyā maṇḍalam aṣṭa devībhiḥ saṃpūjya pāpa deśanā ādikam yāvat kūṭāgāram tatra dvi puṭam maṇḍalam trayoviṃśati śava āsana sahitam pratiśavam urasi candre ālikā ali ja candra sūrya sva sva bīja cihna bīja pariṇatāḥ trayoviṃśati 307 v618 yoginyaḥ bhāvanīyāḥ

original: tadanu herukatrayābhisamayavac cakṣurādyadhiṣṭhānaṃ yāvad abhiṣekaṃ vicintya nairātmyāvajrāgaurīvārīvajraḍākinyo 'kṣobhyavairocanaratnasaṃbhavāmitābhāmoghasiddhibhir gaurīcaurīvettālīghasmaryaḥ pukkasīśabarīcaṇḍālīḍombyaś cākṣobhyavairocanaratnasaṃbhavāmitābhair bhūcarī vairocanena khecary amitābhena hayāsyādayo (308r/619) vajrāṅkuśyādibaddhaṃ
analyzed: tadanu heruka traya abhisamaya vat cakṣuḥ ādi adhiṣṭhānam yāvat abhiṣekam vicintya kṣobhya vairocana ratna saṃbhava amitābha amoghasiddhibhiḥ gaurī caurī vettālī ghasmaryaḥ pukkasī śabarī caṇḍālī ḍombyaḥ ca akṣobhya vairocana ratna saṃbhava amitābhaiḥ bhūcarī vairocanena khecarī amitābhena hayāsya ādayaḥ vajrāṅkuśī ādi baddham

original: vaṃśādayaś ca vajrasattvamaṇḍala iva mudraṇīyāḥ | tato 'paraṃ sarvaṃ herukatrayābhisamayoktaṃ pratipattavyam iti ||
analyzed: vaṃśa ādayaḥ ca vajra sattva maṇḍale iva mudraṇīyāḥ param sarvam heruka traya abhisamaya uktam pratipattavyam iti

original: āmnāyamañjaryāṃ śrīsaṃpuṭaṭīkāyām ekādaśī mañjarī ||
analyzed: āmnāyamañjaryām śrī saṃpuṭa ṭīkāyām ekādaśī mañjarī
